title: At launch, you’ll have nine new dungeons to add to your leveling journey...

author: World of Warcraft
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever launches with nine brand new dungeons for players to experience, including the haunted Hall of Thanes below Ironforge, the lore-rich Ruins of Lordaeron, and the deadly Excavation Site: Wetlands. 
Learn more at: https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/forever
